title: Recruitment
subtitle: Job requisitions, candidates, interviews and offers across the organization.
teamSubtitle: Requisitions of your departments and their candidates (read-only).
demoDataNote: Demo data — fictional candidates and companies. Publishing, invitations and offers are simulated: nothing is sent.
readOnlyNote: You have read-only access to recruitment. You can submit feedback for interviews you are assigned to.

requisitionStatusHints.draft: The requisition goes back to draft for changes.
requisitionStatusHints.pending-approval: The requisition is submitted for approval.
requisitionStatusHints.open: The requisition opens for applications. Publishing is simulated — nothing is posted anywhere.
requisitionStatusHints.on-hold: No new applications are accepted while on hold. Candidates already in process stay.
requisitionStatusHints.closed: Closes the requisition. It can be reopened later.
requisitionStatusHints.cancelled: Cancelling is final and is refused once someone has been hired.

offerStatusHints.draft: The offer goes back to draft.
offerStatusHints.sent: Simulated: the offer is marked as sent. No e-mail is sent to the candidate.
offerStatusHints.accepted: Records the candidate's acceptance: the candidate becomes Hired, and the requisition closes once all vacancies are filled.
offerStatusHints.rejected: Records that the candidate declined the offer. A new offer can be prepared.
offerStatusHints.expired: Offers expire automatically after their expiry date.
offerStatusHints.withdrawn: Withdraws the offer. A new offer can be prepared.

kpis.label: Recruitment key figures
kpis.openPositionsHint: Vacancies still to fill in open requisitions.
kpis.totalCandidatesHint: Candidates in your scope, archived ones excluded.
kpis.inInterviewHint: Candidates currently in the interview stage.
kpis.pendingOffersHint: Offers sent and waiting for the candidate's answer.

funnel.title: Hiring funnel
funnel.subtitle: Candidates reaching each step (conversion from applications)

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.subtitle: Latest pipeline, interview and offer events.

requisitions.title: Job requisitions
requisitions.search: Search by number or job title
requisitions.draftNote: New requisitions start as drafts. Submit them for approval, then open them for applications.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.search: Search by name, e-mail or candidate number
candidates.emailHint: One active application per e-mail address.
candidates.salaryHint: Optional. Visible to recruitment staff only.
candidates.archiveText: Archived candidates are read-only and hidden from the directory. Their history is kept.

pipeline.title: Recruitment pipeline
pipeline.limited: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} candidates — filter by requisition to see all.
pipeline.loadError: The pipeline could not be loaded.
pipeline.rejectHint: Rejecting cancels the candidate's scheduled interviews.
pipeline.reopenHint: The candidate returns to the stage they were rejected from. The change is recorded in the history.

interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.simulatedNote: Simulated scheduling: no invitation, e-mail or calendar event is sent.
interviews.teamNote: Interviews of your departments' candidates, and interviews you take part in.
interviews.candidateHint: The candidate must be shortlisted, in interview or in assessment.
interviews.completeText: Interviewers can then submit their feedback.
interviews.noShowTitle: Mark the candidate as a no-show?
interviews.noShowText: The interview is recorded as not attended.

feedback.title: Interview feedback — {{name}}
feedback.privacy: Feedback is visible to recruitment staff; each other interviewer sees only their own.
feedback.hidden: Feedback submitted by other interviewers is not visible to you ({{count}}).
feedback.finalNote: Feedback cannot be changed after it is submitted.

offers.title: Offers
offers.search: Search by offer number or candidate
offers.draftNote: Offers start as drafts. Sending is simulated — no e-mail is sent.
offers.simulatedNote: Offers are simulated: sending only records the status; candidate answers are recorded by recruitment staff.
offers.expiryHint: The offer expires after this date; it must be on or before the start date.

conversion.title: Create employee
conversion.heading: Create the employee record for {{name}}
conversion.hint: Employee Management's form, pre-filled from the candidate and the accepted offer. Complete the missing details (date of birth, nationality, emergency contact…). The candidate is linked to the new employee and keeps their recruitment history.
conversion.readyHint: Offer accepted: this candidate can now be converted into an employee record.
conversion.needsHr: Offer accepted. An HR user with permission to create employees can convert this candidate into an employee record.
conversion.converted: This candidate has been converted into an employee record.
conversion.notReady: Only hired candidates with an accepted offer can be converted, once.
conversion.noPermission: Creating employees requires the recruitment and employee management permissions.

details.forbidden: This record is outside your access.

validation.invalidUrl: Enter a full address starting with https://
validation.range: Enter a value in the allowed range.
validation.invalidDateTime: Enter a valid date and time.
validation.closingBeforeOpening: The closing date must be on or after the opening date.
validation.salaryMaxBelowMin: The maximum must not be lower than the minimum.
validation.meetingLinkRequired: Video interviews need a meeting link.
validation.expiryAfterStart: The offer must expire on or before the start date.

serverErrors.positionDepartment: This position belongs to another department.
serverErrors.belowHired: Vacancies cannot be lower than the number already hired.
serverErrors.closingPast: The closing date has passed — update it before opening.
serverErrors.hasHires: A requisition with hires cannot be cancelled.
serverErrors.filled: All vacancies are filled. Increase the vacancies to reopen.
serverErrors.duplicateEmail: Another active candidate already uses this e-mail address.
serverErrors.requisitionLocked: The requisition can only change before shortlisting.
serverErrors.requisitionNotOpen: This requisition is not open for applications.
serverErrors.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future.
serverErrors.hiredViaOffer: A candidate becomes Hired only by accepting an offer.
serverErrors.finalStage: Hired and rejected are final stages. Reopen a rejected candidate first.
serverErrors.invalidTransition: This stage change is not allowed.
serverErrors.activeOffer: The candidate has an open offer — withdraw it first.
serverErrors.notRejected: Only rejected candidates can be reopened.
serverErrors.openProcess: Cancel scheduled interviews and close open offers before archiving.
serverErrors.pastStart: Choose a time in the future.
serverErrors.interviewerBusy: An interviewer already has an interview at this time.
serverErrors.candidateBusy: The candidate already has an interview at this time.
serverErrors.stageNotInterview: Interviews can be scheduled for shortlisted candidates and candidates in interview or assessment.
serverErrors.notStarted: The interview has not started yet.
serverErrors.notInterviewer: This person is not an interviewer of this interview.
serverErrors.noVacancy: All vacancies of this requisition are already filled.
serverErrors.outsideRange: The salary is outside the requisition's salary range.
serverErrors.startPast: The start date must be in the future.
serverErrors.stageNotOffer: Offers can be prepared after the interview stage.
serverErrors.notHired: Only hired candidates with an accepted offer can be converted.
serverErrors.stateChanged: This record changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
